title: Claude Code will settle at 25% higher weekly limits in September
friendlyTitle: Claude Code keeps higher limits, but less than users have today
summary: Anthropic says standard weekly Claude Code limits will permanently rise by 25% for Pro, Max, Team and seat-based Enterprise plans from September 14. The current temporary 50% increase remains until then, so available weekly capacity will fall by about 17% from today’s level.
friendlySummary: Weekly limits will be 25% above the normal level from September 14. Because today’s temporary boost is 50%, users will actually have about 17% less capacity than they have now.
whyItMatters: The permanent baseline is higher, but users currently consuming the temporary allowance should expect less capacity in September. Teams can review usage now and move heavy batch work or parallel agents away from the new weekly ceiling.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Heavy users should check their usage and plan for a smaller weekly allowance in September.
